title: A session start refused on another session's turn queues for the next owner turn
why: Degen ledger D27: a start refused on a turn another session began lands on an idle lane instead of waiting for the owner.
source: retrospective 21:38 CST Nov 12; plans/degen-report-2026-11-12.md (restart-plan 4b915b4d), row D27
note: When a session start is refused on a turn another session began, the coordinator queues it for the next owner turn, not an idle lane. Borrowing lanes is already ruled (session-tiers.md:143,179). Lane 23:25 CST Nov 12: read D27 as a record rule; one bullet rewritten in docs/decisions/lanes-start-as-agents.md, PR 3085, no test (the app refuses the start, no hook sees it). Triage 23:26 CST: right reading; one incident, so a record rule now and a guard or coordinator check only if it repeats (rule building-guard-needs-incident).
